**Cause** — In `Model._check_ordering()` (`django/db/models/base.py`), the related-field validation loop only accepted a trailing name if it resolved as a **transform** (`fld.get_transform(part) is None` → error). `isnull` is a **lookup**, not a transform, so `get_transform('isnull')` returns `None` and E015 was wrongly raised. This regression came in with #29408 (commit `440505cb`, present in HEAD); upstream fixed it one day after this checkout in `b73e66e758` ("Fixed #31538 -- Fixed Meta.ordering validation lookups that are not transforms").

if fld is None or (
    fld.get_transform(part) is None and fld.get_lookup(part) is None
):
